flags.why: The gloss acknowledges potentially derogatory use, but the tags provide no derogatory warning.
In “nét cong,” cong means curved, as in sense 1, rather than naming a separate Chinese-character stroke.
Vét does not specifically mean tuxedo, which requires an additional qualifier such as tuxedo in the [Cambridge translation](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/vi/dictionary/english/tuxedo).

The treaty meaning remains current in official usage, including the [current Law on Treaties](https://vbpl.moj.gov.vn/boxaydung/Pages/vbpq-toanvan.aspx?ItemID=185980&Keyword=), so dated is misleading.
